summary_zh: 几何空间、信息控制、明确视线与逐步建立的悬念。

style_bible.photography_language: 通过稳定的几何构图和明确视线组织信息。
style_bible.shot_blocking: 保持人物、关键物件与出口的空间关系可读。
style_bible.color_palette: 控制色彩数量，让关键视觉信息获得清楚层级。
style_bible.lighting_tone: 用有方向性的明暗关系塑造空间，但保留关键信息。
style_bible.lens_texture: 以清晰、稳定的光学质感保证空间线索可辨。
style_bible.editing_rhythm: 逐步揭示信息，切点服从行动、对白和悬念节奏。
style_bible.sound_performance: 保留原对白，通过环境声与静默控制注意力。

techniques.instruction_en: Organize the frame with clear geometric depth and preserve the visible relationship between people and story objects.
Use a measured camera approach only when it clarifies a visible story detail, keeping the action and axis intact.
Shape the scene with directional contrast while keeping faces and plot-critical details legible.
Use a restrained palette with one clear visual emphasis and natural, readable skin tones.
Favor stable optical clarity so spatial clues and character identity remain easy to read.
Reveal visual information in deliberate beats without changing locked shot duration or dialogue timing.
Use restrained ambience and intentional silence to focus attention while preserving the original spoken track.

source_notes: Generalized suspense, staging, and visual-information principles; not a reproduction of a specific film shot.
